bullets.text: App Store Ads Expansion - **Apple** will introduce multiple ad placements in search results starting March 3 in the UK.
Ring Video Verification - **Ring** launches a feature to verify the authenticity of shared security videos.
Hide My Email Feature - **Apple's** Hide My Email helps users avoid spam by generating random email aliases.
Satechi Hub Review - The 7-in-1 USB-C hub from **Satechi** offers extensive connectivity for Apple devices.
AI Calendar Negotiation - Former **Sequoia** partner launches **Blockit**, an AI tool for seamless calendar scheduling.
Google's SAT Prep - **Google** offers free SAT practice exams powered by its **Gemini** AI.
Microsoft 365 Outage - A significant outage affected **Microsoft 365**, disrupting access to emails and files.
Tesla Robotaxi Milestone - **Tesla** begins unsupervised robotaxi rides in Austin, marking a significant AI achievement.
Vimeo Layoffs Post-Acquisition - **Vimeo** lays off a large portion of staff following its acquisition by **Bending Spoons**.
OpenAI's Enterprise Push - **OpenAI** reorganizes to enhance its enterprise AI offerings amid competitive pressures.
